text:
LumenPath-PO: hey team — we want to onboard a custom clinical triage model. PHI in outputs is a hard no. Target p95 latency <= 350ms, throughput ~30 rps. Can Redwood support vocab additions + private deployment?

Ava (CSM): thanks — capturing. tagging @Miguel and @Priya. we need compatibility, safety checklist, and an eval plan. also FYI renewal in ~60 days so this is high priority.

Miguel (SE): quick Q: will you be adding domain tokens to the tokenizer (new vocab)? that can affect KV caching and our quantized model paths. also which deployment: Dedicated or Private (VPC/on-prem)?

LumenPath-PO (customer): yes — ~15k new tokens (triage taxonomy). we can provide redacted samples via secure upload. prefer Private on-prem for PHI.

Priya (Safety): flagged. For PHI we require: token-level redaction, disabled raw-token logging, KMS-backed key control, and an eval for prompt-injection + hallucination risk. please fill this quick template: https://redwood.inc/safety-templates/lumenpath (upload creds will be ephemeral).

Ava (CSM): scheduling an enablement + kickoff call. proposed Wed 10am PT — OK? I'll also add an account health note and open an internal escalation if we see blockers.

Sophie (RevOps): noted on renewal risk. I'll open a renewal watch ticket and add success criteria so CSM/SE work maps to contract milestones.

Miguel (SE): I can spin up a staging harness on Dedicated to run compatibility checks (model conversion + tokenization). I need: 1) sample prompts (2000 diversified cases), 2) a small token-addition map, 3) expected label set for triage outputs. ETA for initial results: EOD Fri.

Miguel (SE): example eval runner (quick):
```bash
# run locally against staging endpoint
curl -X POST https://staging.redwood.internal/eval \
  -H 'Authorization: Bearer <STAGING_KEY>' \
  -H 'Content-Type: application/json' \
  -d '{"cases": "s3://secure-upload/lumenpath/samples.jsonl", "metrics": ["p95_latency","accuracy","hallucination_rate"]}'
```

onboard-bot: Secure upload link created: https://files.redwood.com/secure-upload/abc123 (expires in 7 days).

LumenPath-PO (customer): uploading now. confirm that token-level logs will be disabled and that KMS policy will be applied to model artifacts?

Priya (Safety): yes — logging will be disabled for that tenant, only aggregated telemetry kept. KMS + optional HSM wrap required before we accept artifacts. we'll run differential privacy checks on any released evals.

Ava (CSM): perfect. I'll create the enablement invite and post the dial-in details here. also adding acceptance criteria: pass safety checklist, p95 <=350ms on Private infra, and successful privacy signoff.

Miguel (SE): i'll post conversion notes and any tokenization conflicts in this thread by EOD Fri.

LumenPath-PO (customer): thanks all — we'll join Wed call. :thumbsup:

Ava (CSM): thanks — capturing action items: Miguel -> compat eval (EOD Fri), Priya -> safety template review (tomorrow), Sophie -> renewal watch ticket, Ava -> enablement invite + OKR card. we'll update status here.
